correctness.rationale: The repaired finding passes. The original phrase ‘unique order-six action’ is not literally correct for arbitrary faithful μ₆-actions: inversion gives another identification with the same cyclic group, and the group is abelian. The corrected RESULT.md states uniqueness of the tangent-normalized marked action, retains the unmarked twist classification, and credits the exact catalogue polynomials separately from the model-level assignment. For correctness, the quartic on the right has four simple roots and the unique point at infinity is smooth. Normalization gives r²=8; in particular r≠0,±2 and the full automorphism group is C₆. The coordinate Kummer classes in the split μ₃ and μ₂ factors independently exhaust the six forms. For the Hasse–Witt check, putting h(v)=v²+v+5, the relevant coefficients of h⁴ at v⁶ and h⁸ at v⁶,v¹² are 0,0,11 modulo 13. The common binomial coefficient for the middle entry is 495≡1, yielding 11A⁸d¹²=11A⁸. The resulting stable rank is one and the a-number is two. Exhaustive independent cube-map tabulation over all three fields gives the same point counts for both d at each fixed A: (16,244,2128), (19,145,2128), and (7,121,2128). Newton identities and reciprocal symmetry give the three distinct full polynomials, and Tate's theorem gives the asserted isogeny classes. In the repaired Prym argument the quotient W²=7−4X³/A is ordinary by its nonzero Hasse coefficient; the remaining quartic has reciprocal roots √13 times primitive twelfth roots of unity, and the quadratic-field norm calculation rules out a rational quadratic factor.
residual_risks: Finite enumeration exhausts precisely the fields of degrees one, two and three; the functional equation, not numerical extrapolation, determines all other degrees. The action statement is about the marked action only. The archived verifier remains unchanged and can be replayed as documented in the original package.

The surviving distinct claim is the assignment of these specific six nonhyperelliptic forms to those particular three classes, with exactly two per class and invariance under all three quadratic-twist pairings. residual_risks: A preexisting unindexed explicit model-level computation or earlier genus-three curve list is not ruled out. The LMFDB association check is limited to its inspected class entries and does not establish global literature priority.

value.rationale: The six forms are the complete twist orbit of a distinguished arithmetic curve from the exceptional a-number locus, not an arbitrary handful of quartics. The exact partition shows that the cubic component changes the finite-field Jacobian isogeny class while the quadratic component does not, even though the twists remain nonisomorphic. It identifies explicit nonhyperelliptic Jacobians in two classes for which the inspected database entries do not establish such existence. That model-level information is not a recomputation of the abstract class polynomials.
residual_risks: This is an exact invariant for one geometrically distinguished orbit, not a statement about all primes, all genus-three Jacobians, or polarization/isomorphism classes.
